text:
maria: FYI, rollout v2.3.1 started at 08:08 UTC — we're seeing p90 token latency spike on prod-region-1 starting 08:12. Suspect tokenizer change. Anyone else? 

deploy-bot: Release v2.3.1 promoted to prod at 08:08 by ci/cd (pipeline #4281)

eli: Confirmed. p90 generation latency from 120ms -> 600ms on model-redwood-open-1. Throughput down ~40% on the same pool.

sara: Quick profiler snapshot (10s sample) from one of the hot GPUs:
```
hot_kernels:
 - generic_attention.so: 52% (fallback)
 - matmul_fp16_generic: 28%
 - kv_cache_lock: 9%
 - io_copy: 6%
```
Also KV cache hit-rate: 12% (typical 70-80%).

vikram: Looks like kernel selector is falling back to the generic attention path. New tokenizer seems to produce more fragmented tokens -> more short prefix matches and lots of KV cache misses, causing recompute and weird batching alignment.

ops-sre: Checked host metrics — no obvious noisy-tenant (cpu_steal ~0.5%). Network and storage LBs normal. Hosts 10.2.3.44-47 show increased GPU utilization but not OOM.

maria: So likely workload shape change (seq-len distribution) from tokenizer updates, not infra. Can we pin the model to old tokenizer or force kernel variant?

eli: Two mitigations: 1) rollback tokenizer to v1.9 for the rollout, 2) hotpatch kernel routing to prefer fast_fp16_attention for the model id. I can prepare a routing override.

sara: I'll open a canary rollback and also start an override. Command to set routing override (temporary):
```
curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/v1/overrides \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
 -d '{"model":"model-redwood-open-1","kernel_pref":"fast_fp16_attention","expire_minutes":60}'
```

runtime-bot: Kernel routing override applied to model-redwood-open-1 on pool-prod-region-1 by sara (expires in 60m)

eli: After override, p90 dropped to ~150ms within 90s. KV cache hit-rate climbed back to ~68% as prefix alignment stabilized.

maria: Good patch. We'll roll back tokenizer on canary and re-run perf tests before re-promoting. Also add alert for kv_cache_hit_rate < 30%.

vikram: I'll add the alert and a short eval to compare tokenization distributions between v1.9 and v2.3.1.

ops-sre: Noted. Will keep an eye on the pool and revert override after the rollback is confirmed.

maria: Thanks team — keeping this thread open until rollback completes. :eyes:
